Gemini Watermark Remover: logo mask credits and licences
=========================================================

The Gemini Watermark Remover at /tools/gemini-watermark-remover uses four
calibrated captures of Gemini's visible sparkle logo, taken over pure black,
to know the logo's opacity at every pixel. The captures come from two MIT
licensed projects and are shipped unchanged, embedded in the page's
JavaScript (frontend/src/lib/gemini-watermark/masks.ts in the PrivaTools
source). Only these data files come from those projects. The detection and
removal code is PrivaTools' own.

  Mask        Size     SHA-256 of the PNG                                                 Source
  bg_48       48x48    4afc99afe0ef108d67acc45bf4dc5da867ddb793bebc89c9243bb121ce7f0f57   both projects (identical files)
  bg_96       96x96    3e26f2233a12a5829acac174d8df1f3db40e07fef04ecdd0e035732154077911   both projects (identical files)
  bg_96       96x96    e5e95a3cd28454a1281465519c1b6209c22320856e2bc3074d2386d75cd8bff1   GargantuaX, May 2026 capture
   (20260520)
  bg_b_36     36x36    a3e7d5ca932e6acf9ff826a4db47d597458480e72089da81a40bd4b52668cd31   AllenK, Gemini 3.5 small logo

- GargantuaX/gemini-watermark-remover, commit
  13195610a5b534d69adfa169b1011981c9b6f499: src/assets/bg_48.png,
  src/assets/bg_96.png and src/assets/bg_96_20260520.png.
  https://github.com/GargantuaX/gemini-watermark-remover
- allenk/GeminiWatermarkTool, commit
  7c6a99f2c3df97eb3c430ef87a0c962aea5cb80e: bg_48_png, bg_96_png and
  bg_b_36_png, the PNG files embedded in assets/embedded_assets.hpp.
  https://github.com/allenk/GeminiWatermarkTool

AllenK's project notice identifies him as the author of the calibrated 48 and
96 px masks and asks that redistributions keep the copyright notice and the
full licence text, both below, with a link back to his repository (above).

The tool removes only the visible logo. It does not remove, weaken or look
for SynthID or any other invisible or metadata provenance signal.
